citations.quote: Asked whether this is connected with the door, he said they do not know; she has an appointment with her doctor and it has not been clarified.
He did not want to claim anything in that respect at this stage.
He states clearly that if the lock is not repaired he will pay his rent into the official deposit account (Hinterlegungsstelle) rather than to Wohnwerk Thur.
I have reported several times that the front door of my flat cannot be locked. I hereby ask you once more to have the lock repaired as soon as possible.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The dated letter identifies the lock defect and asks the landlord to repair it.
The letter does not establish whether or when the landlord received it.
Objective dated evidence of the affected door and defect is missing.
The reported lack of action and any proposed work or access arrangements need supporting records.
Mould is unmentioned and presumed absent for planning.
Heating is unmentioned and presumed absent for planning.
A possible health connection was raised but remains open and is not currently claimed.
A need for specialist inspection is unmentioned and presumed absent for planning.
The deposit route is considered, but the supplied letter requests repair as soon as possible without a specific deadline.
It is optional under the process.

questions: Is the unsecured door creating an immediate safety risk, and is a temporary securing measure needed?
Does Mr Solberg wish to raise health effects in connection with the defect, and has the doctor provided any findings?
